source: 外研社版必修第二册 Unit 2 同主题完形(惊喜生日会/手作灯笼/中秋月饼/校园化装舞会/除夕烟花/自创节日)。用词限 U2/初中/常见词,答案唯一,4选项同词性,与阅读/听力关不撞文章。

passages.title: A Surprise Birthday Party
passages.text: Last Saturday we planned a surprise party for my best friend Mia. We wanted to (1)____ her birthday in a special way. In the afternoon, we (2)____ the living room with balloons and bright paper flowers. My brother hid the cake in the kitchen so that Mia would not (3)____ it. At six o'clock, we turned off the lights and waited (4)____. When she opened the door, we all shouted, and the look of (5)____ on her face was wonderful. She said she had never expected such a warm (6)____. We sang together, and then everyone (7)____ a small gift in front of her. Mia was so happy that she almost (8)____. Later we played games and guessed funny (9)____ written on cards. It was a night full of (10)____, and none of us wanted it to end.

questions.explanation: celebrate her birthday 庆祝生日。
decorated the room with balloons 用气球布置房间。
so that she would not find it 以免她发现。
是惊喜,所以安静地等待 quietly。
脸上是惊喜的表情 the look of surprise。
such a warm welcome 如此热情的欢迎。
placed a gift in front of her 把礼物放在她面前。
so happy that she almost cried 高兴得几乎哭出来。
guessed funny riddles 猜有趣的谜语。
a night full of joy 充满欢乐的夜晚。

passages.title: Making a Paper Lantern
passages.text: During the festival season, my grandmother taught me how to make a paper (1)____ at home. First, we chose a sheet of bright red (2)____, because red is the colour of good luck. She showed me how to (3)____ the paper neatly in half and cut thin lines along one side. Then we (4)____ the two ends together to form a round shape. We added a handle made of (5)____ so that it could be carried easily. Grandmother told me to work (6)____, or the thin paper would tear. When it was (7)____, we placed a small light inside, and the whole lantern began to (8)____ softly. I felt very (9)____ of the bright little lamp I had made with my own hands. That evening, we hung it by the (10)____ for everyone passing by to enjoy.

questions.explanation: make a paper lantern 做纸灯笼。
a sheet of red paper 一张红纸。
fold the paper in half 把纸对折。
joined the two ends together 把两端接在一起。
a handle made of string 用绳子做的提手。
薄纸易破,要小心地做 carefully。
when it was finished 做好之后。
the lantern began to glow 灯笼开始发光。
proud of the lamp I made 为自己做的灯感到自豪。
hung it by the window 把它挂在窗边。

passages.title: The Mid-Autumn Festival
passages.text: The Mid-Autumn Festival is one of the most loved (1)____ in China. It is held in the eighth lunar month, when the moon is at its (2)____ and roundest. On this night, families gather outdoors to (3)____ the bright full moon together. The round shape of the moon stands for (4)____, so being with family really matters. The special food of the festival is the (5)____, a small round cake filled with sweet paste. People often (6)____ mooncakes to friends and relatives as gifts. Long ago, farmers also used this time to celebrate the autumn (7)____, giving thanks for a good year. Children love to listen to old (8)____ about a lady who flew to the moon. Today, even Chinese people living (9)____ look up at the same moon and think of home. The festival fills people's hearts with warmth and (10)____.

questions.explanation: one of the most loved festivals 最受喜爱的节日之一。
the moon is at its brightest 月亮最亮。
admire the full moon 赏月。
round shape stands for togetherness 圆象征团圆。
the special food is the mooncake 节日特色食物是月饼。
send mooncakes as gifts 把月饼当礼物送人。
celebrate the autumn harvest 庆祝秋收。
old stories about a lady 关于一位仙女的古老故事。
Chinese people living overseas 居住海外的华人。
warmth and joy 温暖与欢乐。

passages.title: The School Fancy Dress Party
passages.text: Our class held a (1)____ dress party last Friday to celebrate the end of term. Everyone was asked to come (2)____ as a favourite character. I spent the whole evening before putting up balloons and (3)____, so by the night I felt quite tired. When the guests arrived, the classroom looked (4)____ and full of colour. One tall (5)____ came dressed as Batman, and a girl wore a beautiful bride's dress. We could not always (6)____ who was who, which made everyone laugh. Two students dressed as chickens kept (7)____ their arms and waving at us. Our teacher, who is usually very (8)____, even wore a funny hat. We played music, danced, and shared a big (9)____ that one parent had baked. By the end of the night, everyone agreed it had been an evening full of (10)____.

questions.explanation: a fancy dress party 化装舞会。
come dressed as a character 打扮成某个角色来。
balloons and decorations 气球和装饰物。
looked bright and full of colour 看上去明亮多彩。
one tall guy dressed as Batman 一个高个子男生扮成蝙蝠侠。
could not tell who was who 分不清谁是谁。
moving their arms and waving 摆动手臂招手。
usually very strict 平时很严格。
shared a big cake 分享一个大蛋糕。
an evening full of laughter 充满笑声的夜晚。

passages.title: Fireworks on New Year's Eve
passages.text: On New Year's (1)____, my family always goes down to the river to watch the fireworks. We arrive early to find a good (2)____ near the water. As the night grows dark, the crowd by the bank gets (3)____ and more excited. Just before midnight, everyone counts down (4)____ together. Then the first firework shoots up and (5)____ into a thousand points of light. The colours are so (6)____ that the whole sky seems to come alive. Children point upwards and (7)____ with delight, while parents lift the smallest ones onto their shoulders. The light shines on the water, so it looks as if the river is (8)____, too. When the show finally (9)____, we walk home slowly, still talking about the most beautiful moment. For me, those few minutes by the river are the best (10)____ of the whole year.

questions.explanation: New Year's Eve 除夕。
find a good spot 找个好位置。
the crowd gets larger 人群越来越多。
counts down loudly 大声倒数。
shoots up and bursts into light 升空后炸开成光点。
the colours are so bright 颜色如此鲜艳。
point upwards and cheer 指着上方欢呼。
the river is shining 河面也在闪光。
when the show finally ends 表演终于结束时。
the best moments of the year 一年里最美的时刻。

passages.title: Creating a Special Day
passages.text: Have you ever wondered why people (1)____ special days like World Smile Day? Such days are not old traditions; they are (2)____ by ordinary people who want to share a good idea. World Smile Day, for example, (3)____ people to be kind and to pass a smile on to others. The idea is (4)____: one friendly smile can brighten a stranger's whole day. On this day, some schools ask students to do one kind (5)____ for someone else, such as helping a classmate. Shops may give away free badges with a smiling (6)____ on them. The day does not cost much, yet it can (7)____ a lot of warmth among people. Our class once decided to (8)____ our own special day, which we called Thank-You Day. Everyone wrote a short note to someone they were (9)____ to. By the end, the whole school was full of (10)____ faces.

questions.explanation: why people create special days 人们为何创立特别的日子。
they are invented by ordinary people 由普通人发明。
the day encourages people to be kind 鼓励人们友善。
the idea is simple 这个想法很简单。
do one kind act 做一件善事。
a smiling face 一张微笑的脸。
it can bring warmth 能带来温暖。
